description: A real cross-language divergence code review found (2026-09-06): interpolate()'s literal for a null-valued variable used to differ between interpreters (JS's String(null) is "null", Python's str(None) is "None"). schedule_step's own inputs field is the first place a caller plausibly passes a null through templating (an optional recipe input left unset), so this proves both interpreters now render the identical literal.
